response.goal: We get partnership requests by email. We want each new email in our "Partners" Gmail label summarized by an AI model and added to Airtable: sender, company, request type, a 2-sentence summary and a priority flag. A person on our team reviews anything marked low confidence.

plan.step: Configure Python script to poll new emails in the "Partners" Gmail label
Integrate AI model to extract sender, company, request type, 2-sentence summary and priority flag with confidence scoring
Write extracted lead data to Airtable and route low-confidence items for human review

milestones.name: Milestone 1
milestones.deliverable: Gmail fetching and AI extraction script setup

milestones.name: Milestone 2
milestones.deliverable: Airtable integration and low-confidence review routing

proof_map.step: Configure Python script to poll new emails in the "Partners" Gmail label
Integrate AI model to extract sender, company, request type, 2-sentence summary and priority flag with confidence scoring
Write extracted lead data to Airtable and route low-confidence items for human review

risks.risk: Hourly budget constraints or uncertainty on total hours required
risks.mitigation: Provide regular hour tracking updates and weekly status reports.
Include explicit fallback logic to route ambiguous partnership requests to human review.

questions: What specific AI model (OpenAI vs other) should be used for the summary?
What is the exact schema of the Airtable base where leads should be added?
assumptions: The client will provide access credentials to the Gmail account and Airtable base.
The hourly budget of $35-$55 per hour is acceptable.
